info.description:
Wedding guest-list backend. Collaborative RSVP management with
role-based access (owner/editor/viewer), invite links, stats,
activity feed, notifications, and CSV export.

All responses use the envelope `{ "data": ..., "error": null }`.
On error, `data` is null and `error` is `{ "code", "message", "details" }`.
Authenticate via `POST /auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access>`.
